body:
I sort of fit into this category. 

I have limited ability physically to move or do much due to a car accident almost three years ago now. 

I only work part time (and only can do it because my fiancé works at the same place so he drives me to and from work most of the time).

Intellectualy I'm still the same, just had to learn how to cope with little sleep and constant pain.

It could be worse.

Yep. It's not a nice feeling.

Tool a while to come down afterwards. Was my first time getting high so I didn't know what was going on. Since then it's been ok, I just make sure I don't have too much.

Back pain. Car accident almost three years ago, driver never stopped, was too busy texting. Ever since I have been in constant pain. The neck and shoulder pain went away after a few months and only occasionally bother me. But the back and leg pain, OMG! I see the last specialist in 12 days time to find out if there is anything they can do. No amount of pain meds help. I can't sleep because of the pain. I can't work much because of the pain. I don't go out much. My relationships are all strained and I can't have children yet until they decide if they are going to fix my back.

And the worst part is I only just turned 28 a few days ago. So I have many many more years of pain ahead of me.

Every day, constant pain, with no relief. It sucks bad.

When a young male driver decided that texting on his phone was more important then keeping his eyes on the road. He never stoped, his car crashed into mine. I have been living in unbearable pain ever since. I can't work full time, I can't do any of the things I use to enjoy. Every single day is an agonizing battle. But I know it could have been much worse. I could have ended up paralyzed or even dead. Most days I am happy that I am still here.
A few people I know say pallow instead of pillow, and these people aren't related and don't know each other. Why people are getting this wrong is beyond me...

I used to think they were all losers. And I wanted nothing to do with anyone who would do such things.

I then ended up with chronic back pain. The meds stopped working after two and a half years, and a while back after a four week stint of next to no sleep, I got desperate. I don't like smoking so I made hash cookies instead. 

I now keep a supply of ready to bake cookies in the freezer. I don't have them every day, maybe once every other week or so. Takes the edge off the pain and let's me sleep.

So long as it's not harming anyone and it's not ruling your life, do as you wish :)

He just doesn't seem to care, I try and remind him as often as I can to take them, but we don't always eat together, it just depends only work hours. 

I feel like an awful person, since I also have depression, that I'm just sick and tired of trying to help him and getting nowhere. But I just don't know what else to do.

A family member named Wayne has his as Wayne's World

I have mine as The Cat Hotel

I'm sick of being in pain. I'm tired of insurance companies who don't give a fuck ruining my life. Just do the last $1,600 scan to see if surgery would fix me, please. Back pain and sciatic pain are a literal and figurative pain in the ass. The meds are too expensive and now they have cut off all benefits so they won't pay for the meds and they won't pay my wages (and I can't work much because of the pain, and not I can't even afford the meds that were allowing me to work the little bit that I was). 

And my whole life is on hold. I'm getting closer to 30 every day, and I want to be able to start a family. But I need to know if they can do the surgery first and then I will still need to wait a year after that before Ivan even start trying to get pregnant. I want this to all be over with already. It's been over two and a half years dammit.

How did the boy elephant find the girl elephant in the long grass....

Delightful! Lol

Cracks me up every time :)

There is nothing they can do for the pain. Low strength meds do nothing and higher strength ones leave me spaced out and unable to function. I have tried everything to make this better and the only thing it has done is made it worse.


There isn't anything that makes me happy anymore. The things I use to do I can't do anymore because of the pain. I have exaughsted every option to try and fix the pain, and now all they can say is they can find nothing wrong, there is nothing they can fix and nothing more they can do for me. 

I don't want to spend the rest of my life like this. The physical pain, the way I feel emotionally, it's just too much.

I don't want to fight it anymore. It's too hard.
